subject: Commitment transfer and regional capacity split
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@megacorp.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:22:00Z
Subject: Commitment transfer and regional capacity split

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the help on this. We ran into a data residency constraint for a new EU product line and would like to move a portion of our committed AWS marketplace capacity assigned to our APAC purchase into the EU region. High level ask is: can we reallocate 40% of our committed tokens to EU consumption, keep the remainder in APAC, and preserve the combined committed term and pricing?

What we need from Redwood:
- Guidance on whether this is a private offer amendment or a new private offer.
- Expected timing for a DocuSign amendment we can sign before Nov 10.
- Confirmation on proration and invoice flow so our APAC finance team can reconcile.

I've attached a short usage projection for Q4 that shows the split we expect. Also copying our finance alias for PO coordination.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Cloud Platform
MegaCorp Health
Attachment: Usage_Projection_Q4.pdf (pdf)

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@megacorp.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-16T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Commitment transfer and regional capacity split

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the projection, that helps. Short answer: we can do this without dropping you to a new price tier, but it will require a PO amendment plus a private-offer update on the marketplace side. Proposed approach:

1) Draft amendment that reallocates 40% of committed capacity to EU SKUs, leaves 60% in APAC. Pricing and term remain unchanged.
2) Create an updated private offer in AWS Marketplace that maps the split to two region-bound SKUs under the same private-offer id, then sign the amendment and accept the private offer.
3) PRORATION: We will pro-rate based on the effective date of the amendment. Invoices will be generated per marketplace rules; we can group invoices to send one consolidated invoice to your APAC finance team if requested.

Timeline we propose:
- Draft amendment + marketplace mapping: 3 business days after confirmation of split
- Legal review + DocuSign: up to 5 business days
- Acceptance and PO capture: within 10 business days to meet your Nov 10 target

Can you confirm the exact legal name and billing address we should use on the amendment, and whether APAC finance wants a single consolidated invoice or separate region invoices? I've attached a quick draft spreadsheet with the proposed split numbers.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft_commitment_split.xlsx (xlsx)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: olivia.chen@megacorp.com
Date: 2026-10-20T14:30:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Commitment transfer and regional capacity split

Priyom / Ben —

Looping in billing and legal notes here. Quick summary and asks for ops:

- Legal: we should use an amendment template that specifies the split as a percentage of the committed baseline and references the original private-offer id. I attached the standard amendment template.
- Finance (Ben): confirm invoicing options. Per prior marketplace behavior we can either a) create two private-offer line items and let marketplace produce region-specific invoices, or b) maintain one consolidated seller invoice by grouping charges post-invoice. Option a) is simpler for AWS reconciliation; option b) helps MegaCorp keep a single PO.
- Operational note: if MegaCorp requires the EU portion to be isolated for data residency, recommend mapping to a region-specific SKU rather than a label-only split. That avoids routing issues and simplifies SLO mapping.

Action items:
- Ben: can you confirm whether we can support consolidated invoicing for this customer and any internal steps?
- Priyom: once Olivia confirms legal name/billing address, I'll spin the amendment and the marketplace mapping.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: amendment_template.docx (docx)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@megacorp.com>

Cc: apac-finance@megacorp.com
Date: 2026-11-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Commitment transfer and regional capacity split

Hi Priyom / Kim,

Thanks for the clear plan. We reviewed internally and confirm:

- Legal name for amendment: MegaCorp Health Pty Ltd
- Billing address: 12 Strandway Ave, Dublin, IE, 4D7 9GH
- Finance preference: APAC finance prefers a single consolidated invoice that lists both region line items under one PO number. If AWS Marketplace cannot produce that natively, our APAC team can accept separate invoices but will need a reconciliation file.

We approve the 40% EU / 60% APAC split as proposed. Please proceed with the amendment and marketplace mapping. Target: we need the DocuSign envelope live by Nov 8 to ensure internal approvals and PO issuance by Nov 10.

Also, please preserve the existing SLA commitments and the uplift credits agreed in the original contract. We will need a one-page summary that shows no change to SLOs or credit entitlements post-split.

Attaching the signed term summary we prepared for your review.

Olivia Chen
Head of Cloud Platform
MegaCorp Health
Attachment: Signed_Term_Summary.pdf (pdf)
